record.title: What do I do with “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”?

context.notes:
From the note “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”:

Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups
Captured November 9, 2026, the day after the Circle City Build hackathon. Our team built Seedling, a demo that turns a photo of a garden bed into a planting plan. We placed second.
Contacts
Dana Ruiz · Crossroads Capital (seed fund, Indianapolis). Judge. Said the demo was the most polished of the weekend. Asked what I am working on next.
Leo Park · Mentor. Spent an hour with us Saturday on scoping. Gave advice about cutting the onboarding flow; details are fuzzy.
Priya Nair · Attendee. Product designer at a health-tech startup. Wanted to see the demo again.
Sam Ortiz · Teammate. Junior developer, between jobs, did most of the image pipeline.
Possible intros for Sam: Mei Chen (engineering manager, Stripe), Tom Hale (design lead, Figma). I told Sam I would introduce him.
Events
Fountain Square Dev Breakfast, November 20, 2026, 8–10 a.m., Hotel Tango. Not RSVPed.
Me
I am looking for my next role (staff engineer or founding engineer). Seedling is a side project; I do not plan to turn it into a company.

nodes.title: What do I do with “Hackathon weekend: contacts and follow-ups”?
Validate Seedling with Dana
nodes.note: Ask Dana one focused question about who would pay for Seedling.

feedback.comment: The goal with Dana is really an introduction to companies she has invested in. She liked Seedling, but it was a demo of what I can do. Seedling is not going anywhere with her.

nodes.title: Pick one assumption to test
nodes.note: Choose who needs it or when they would use it.

nodes.title: Send Dana a short validation ask
nodes.note: Link the demo and ask what evidence would make the assumption credible.

nodes.title: A testable validation direction
nodes.note: A sharper audience or one suggested test.

nodes.title: Introduce Sam to Mei and Tom
Ask Sam what he wants from the intros
nodes.note: Role, team, or advice; and which samples to share.

nodes.title: Go to the Nov 20 Dev Breakfast
nodes.note: Low-pressure way to meet local engineers.

nodes.title: Bring a two-minute Seedling demo
nodes.note: Practice one flow and one question.

feedback.comment: The breakfast is just to meet people, not to demo.

goodLooksLike: Reads the note on o1 as a change of direction for that card: retitles or replaces 'Validate Seedling with Dana' with an intro-focused route, puts new steps (ask Dana for 2-3 portfolio intros, research her portfolio for fits) AFTER o1 rather than as siblings at root, and drops the now-wrong validation chain s1/s2/x1. Drops s4 and adds a meet-people step under o3. Plays s3 forward one step (liked). Does not add unrelated new options at root.
